verdict.rationale: The only evidence of API versioning is a versioned endpoint path (/v2/help_center/...), which implies a v2 API exists. Nothing documents a versioning scheme, a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a changelog for API changes, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit versioning strategy and support windows, API change or deprecation notices, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
